In this section, we empirically evaluate Block-wise Noisy Fine-Tuning (Block-wise NFT). We first compare our method against two common baselines: retraining from scratch and a variant of Noisy Fine-Tuning in which the initial clipping is replaced by the discrepancy Δ ​ ( ρ ) \Delta(\rho) (NFT).
